_comment: The pack this graph is built for: github.com/lbouaraba/comfyui-krea2edit,
which is what the krea2_identity_edit LoRAs were trained against.
ComfyUI's native Krea 2 forward builds the sequence [text | target].
Krea2EditModelPatch rebuilds it as [text | source(RoPE frame=1) |
target(frame=0)] and keeps only the target tokens out, which is the
appearance path the LoRA needs. Krea2EditGroundedEncode is the second
half of the same conditioning: the instruction is encoded while
Qwen3-VL LOOKS at the source. Both are required — with a plain
CLIPTextEncode the model never sees the image semantically and
scene-referential instructions ('the man on the left') fall apart.
target_latent is wired from node 7 on purpose. Without it the node
cannot know the output resolution until sampling starts, so the
source VAE-encode lands on the first step — with the diffusion model
already resident. ComfyUI frees room by partially offloading the
sampler, nothing loads it back, and every remaining step then streams
Node 12/14 are the optional second reference (person-into-scene).
A single-reference request drops BOTH: 14 has no pixels without 12.

2._note: The edit LoRA is not optional here the way a style LoRA is in the t2i graph: it IS the recipe. Without it the patched forward feeds source tokens to a model never trained to read them.

3._note: GGUF conditioner: ~1 s to build where the fp8_scaled safetensors takes ~700 s on gfx1201. Both edit node packs feed images THROUGH this encoder, so it must carry the Qwen3-VL vision tower — for the GGUF that is the mmproj companion, mapped in by our ComfyUI-GGUF patch.

5._note: Positive: the edit instruction, grounded on the source. grounding_px is a quality dial, not a size limit — lower favours instruction adherence, higher favours likeness.

6._note: Negative: an EMPTY prompt grounded on the same image — the trained unconditional. Unused at cfg 1.0 (ComfyUI skips the uncond pass), and the right branch the moment a removal edit raises cfg above 1.

7._note: EmptySD3LatentImage, not EmptyLatentImage: Krea 2's VAE is 16-channel and this latent is read by the patch node for the target geometry, not only by the sampler (which would have fixed the channel count itself).

10._note: fit_mode is set from the LoRA version, not by the operator: v1.2 was trained on 'fit' geometry and v1/v1.1 on 'crop (legacy)'. ref_boost multiplies target->reference attention; the reference workflow ships it at 4.0.
